# Contributing

Use focused issues and feature branches. Link a draft pull request to its issue and record verification and remaining limitations. Keep fixtures synthetic and never commit credentials or real calendar data. Use parent/sub-issues and dependency links when they clarify sequencing; preserve existing project views and fields.

For dependent branches, follow [Stacked PRs](STACKED_PRS.md). The [consolidation proposal](../docs/pr-consolidation-proposal.md) records the current experimental tracks and their preservation requirements; it is not merge authorization.

Use focused intermediate commits. A passing check on an older base does not verify a retargeted or integrated branch. Keep the first runnable synthetic walkthrough separate from later interface, planner and embedding selections. PR #8's merge and those selections retain their explicit user decision gates.
